newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Early days on rate cuts-Australia's Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Early days on rate cuts-Australia's Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that it was still "early days" in relation to the impact of recent interest rate cuts.
"It's still early days in relation to the cuts in official interest rates as they begin to come on stream," Costello told Parliament.
Costello said retail sales and confidence were picking up.
"As you see that pick-up in retail sales and confidence, we would expect a picture of continuing and growing strength throughout 1997," he said.
Official data released earlier on Tuesday showed retail sales increased 2.7 percent in January, seasonally-adjusted, from the previous month.
Separate figures also showed building approvals increased 10.4 percent in January, seasonally-adjuested, as the industry fights its way out of a prolonged slump.
Australia's central bank, the Reserve Bank, cut official cash rates by 1.5 percentage points in three separate cuts over the last six months of calendar 1996.
The official cash interest rate now stands at 6.0 percent.
